driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant car baseline from Saval et al. Parameters tuned to match low discharge headway (M1/car) and high stop-line overshoot depth for motorcycles by allowing tight following.
Car violators drawing from car distribution; currently compliant (p=0) to match M3/share/car low red-running and M2/early/car near-zero early start.
Compliant motorcycle baseline from Saval et al. minGap=1.9m and minGapLat=0.3m are tuned to reproduce the observed high overshoot share (M4/overshoot_share) and lateral position (M4/lat_moto).
Violator motorcycle drawing from moto distribution; identical physical params to moto_saval but enabled for queue_space_seeking rules (p_wrong_lane) and illegal_left_box rules.

Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); jmTimegapMinor=1.0s is the default lever for box-waiting duration; physical behaviour same as compliant motos but with different distribution.

traci_rules.rationale: Matches Saval et al. 2023 Sec 4 (front-row motorcycle red-running probability ~0.5); k=0 removes swarm effect as no follower influence observed; p_max caps probability.
Targets M2/early/moto (observed share 0.1303); p=0.13 approximates the probability of creeping over the stop line in the last 10s of red, with v_max=2 m/s limiting speed to slow rolling.

Targets M8/moto wrong-lane share (0.2131) and M9a (queue blocking); q=50m triggers seeking at moderate queues, t_g_s=7s estimates green clearance, p_wrong_lane=0.21 sets the observed wrong-lane share; est_noise provides slight estimation error.
Field observation: most motorcycles pass a standing U-turner; p=0.8 captures high bypass probability, t_wait=2s is the short hold before deciding.
Field observation: cars rarely bypass standing U-turners; p=0.1 reflects low probability compared to motorcycles.
